title: Buffering Byte Input
goal: Adapt a generic reader to read line by line.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Standard Traits

hints: Wrap the generic reader in a `BufReader` instance first.
explanation: `Read` only provides low-level byte operations like `read` or `bytes`. Calling `lines` directly on `Read` triggers `E0599` because `lines` is defined on `BufRead`. Wrapping the input in `BufReader::new` provides the required trait implementation. `bytes` compiles on `Read`, but counts raw bytes instead of newline-delimited strings.
